chunks: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Hāshim al-Bajalī narrated from Abū Khadījah, who said:

It is not appropriate for two women to sleep under one blanket unless there is a barrier between them. If they do so, they are to be forbidden from that; then if they are found after the prohibition under one blanket, each one of them is to be lashed with a hadd punishment. If they are found a third time under one blanket, they are to receive the hadd punishment; and if they are found a fourth time under one blanket, they are to be killed. And when a man goes to his wife and she carries his semen, then performs musāḥaqah with her slave-girl by means of it and she becomes pregnant, the woman is to be stoned, the slave-girl is to be lashed, and the child is to be affiliated to his father.

key_terms.أُلْحِقَ الْوَلَدُ بِأَبِيهِ: the child is legally attributed to his father
key_terms.حَاجِزٌ: a barrier or separation between two persons
key_terms.رُجِمَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman is to be punished by stoning
key_terms.لِحَافٍ وَاحِدٍ: a single blanket or covering shared while lying together

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about two women sleeping under one blanket and the legal ruling on musāḥaqah?
ai.summary: This hadith states legal rulings concerning repeated unlawful physical intimacy between women and gives escalating penal consequences after repeated occurrence following prohibition. It also addresses a case involving a wife transferring the husband's semen to a slave-girl, specifying the punishments mentioned and affirming the child's attribution to the father.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.5050 - Abd Al-Rahman ibn Abi Hashim Al-Bajali narrated from Abu Khadijah:
"It is not appropriate for two women to sleep under the same blanket unless there is a barrier between them. If they do so, they should be prohibited from it, and if they are found again after being warned in the same blanket, each of them should be lashed the prescribed punishment.
If they are found a third time under the same blanket, they should be punished with the prescribed punishment,
If they are found a fourth time under the same blanket, they should be executed.
And if a man approaches his wife and she carries his semen and uses it to commit lesbian acts with her maid, resulting in pregnancy, the wife should be stoned, the maid should be lashed, and the child should be attributed to the father."
